STEP 1 - Scene: A plated lunch/dinner with a baked dish (lasagna-style with melted cheese), a saucy meat or chicken dish, a green salad with dressing, steamed broccoli, and a rice/vegetable stir-fry with peppers and tomatoes.

STEP 2 - Vessel: Large square-ish white dinner plate, about 26 cm across. Area = 3.14 x 13^2 ≈ 531 cm². The plate at the bottom edge and the small item at the far left edge are not part of the meal beyond what is on the plate.

STEP 3 - Items:
- Lasagna-style baked pasta with cheese (top right, rectangular piece)
- Saucy chicken or meat pieces in red sauce (right side)
- Creamy green salad (romaine/leafy greens with dressing) (left side)
- Broccoli florets (lower center, two clusters)
- Stir-fried rice with peppers, tomato, and broccoli (lower right)

Total covered ≈ 66% of plate, consistent with the visible spread.

- Lasagna: 64 x 3 = 192 ml
- Chicken/meat in sauce: 69 x 2 = 138 ml

- Rice/stir-fry: 69 x 2 = 138 ml

STEP 6 - Grams (bulk density):

- Chicken/meat: 138 x 0.9 = 124 g

STEP 7 - Energy:
- Lasagna: 173 g x 150 kcal/100g = 260 kcal
- Chicken/meat in sauce: 124 g x 170 = 211 kcal
- Salad with dressing: 53 g x 60 = 32 kcal
- Broccoli: 40 g x 34 = 14 kcal
- Rice/stir-fry: 110 g x 130 = 143 kcal

STEP 8 - Sanity check: Total ≈ 500 g and ≈ 660 kcal. This fits a full-looking dinner plate with a substantial baked dish and rice, so the estimate is plausible.

Total: about 500 g, about 660 kcal.
